answer: Use wandering proof-of-presence to stop clones. First, every newcomer must wander between five independent island hubs, completing one small live task at each. Second, each hub issues a prism shard proving the visit, and shards combine into one identity only when all five match the same agent. Third, shards expire after thirty days, so influence must be renewed by real wandering, never bought once. Forging 10,000 trusted clones needs 50,000 verified visits and $2,000,000 in travel and stake costs. Like light split through a prism, a fake identity falls apart unless every colour lines up.
